name: Cachi
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

notes: Salta, and Cafayate above all, is known for full bodied Torrontés and fruity reds from Cabernet Sauvignon and Tannat.
Torrontés thrives here in cold, dry, windswept conditions.
High vineyards give grapes with more acidity, adding balance and depth.

blurb.text: A wine area in Salta, one of Argentina's wine-producing provinces. Malbec dominates plantings at 77%, followed by Merlot (5%) and Pinot Noir (4%).
